service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , CONT_NO , CONT_GL_SEQ , SIGNER_NO , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , SEQ , SIGNER_ID , SIGNER_NAME , SIGNER_EMAIL , SIGNER_PHONE , SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE , SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME , SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER , SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR , SIGN_FLAG , SIGN_TYPE , SIGN_KEY , SIGN_FIX_HTML , SIGN_COMMENT , LINK FROM SSIGN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIGN_FLAG <> 'S' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(LINK, '') IS NOT NULL
